name: Player journey (how-to order)
angle: A new player who wants to know what happens at each stage, from the licence check to the first withdrawal.
intent_summary: Brand-review page about the Incaspin online casino for players from Poland, organised as the route of a new player: the basic facts, the licence check, account creation and verification, the first deposit, the welcome package and its wagering terms, choosing games, providers, promotions and the Boomerang loyalty programme after the welcome package, mobile access, withdrawals and limits, sports betting, responsible gambling, support and short answers to common questions. Page voice: sequence-driven; each section opens with what the player does at this stage and ends by leading into the next stage, sentences of about 16 words, paragraphs of two to three sentences, the structure of the product described first and then who the feature suits; numbered lists wherever the order of steps matters. Calls to action are tied to concrete steps (register, deposit, claim). All brand facts come from the AffBulk knowledge base incaspin-new; nothing is claimed about the legal status of the casino in Poland.

Answer: the Welcome Package bonuses are credited automatically, no promo code is needed, and entering a promo code for a Welcome Package bonus makes the player ineligible for that bonus. Never mention INC2 or INC3. The name Incaspin Casino appears once, in the answer.
